title: DWG raw-object reader and consumer-lineage refresh
scope: Research-only source review; no peer checkout, executable, sample, dependency, or test was run.

sources.sourcePin: Mutable main README as viewed 2026-10-21; no exact commit SHA resolved, so not execution-admitted.
sources.licenseClaim: README/Cargo.toml declare Apache-2.0; source provenance is project-author-declared, not independently audited here.
sourceClaims: Object-stream walker is marked shipped across eight releases and all_objects() returns raw objects with type codes, handles, and raw payload bytes.
Per-entity field decoders remain alpha; the README reports six real-corpus VIEWPORT records failing exact data-stream boundary checks (266 of 1125 bits decoded).
Entity graph resolution is partial; DXF parser is not implemented; external CAD acceptance for its DWG writer is not automated.
sources.disposition: Potential independent raw-structure cross-check only, after exact commit pin and an API admission probe confirms that relevant output versions and handle-tail data are exposed. Do not use typed VIEWPORT decode as acceptance, and do not infer semantic or writer support.

sources.sourcePin: Mutable main README as viewed 2026-10-21; no exact crate/source checksums resolved.
sourceClaims: Read-only project; DWG route uses LibreDWG through Rust FFI.
DXF route uses the pure-Rust undxf crate for ASCII and binary DXF, including R2007 and later.
sources.disposition: DWG evidence is correlated with LibreDWG. undxf remains a possible separately pinned DXF-only comparator, not a writer, DWG, or 3D/ACIS witness.

sources.sourcePin: Mutable main README as viewed 2026-10-21; app release and acadrust source must both be pinned before execution.
sourceClaims: README advertises native DWG/DXF read/write with versioned targets R14 through 2018, a desktop app for Windows/Linux/Apple Silicon macOS, and audit/save_verified automation that reopens output and compares a semantic manifest.
Application source imports acadrust for document/entity types; it is therefore not an independent parser lineage from ACadRust.
sources.disposition: Optional application-level consumer smoke test only. Record exact app release and codec commit and keep the result separate from independent parser, semantic, and FreeCAD qualification.

sources.sourcePin: Mutable main README as viewed 2026-10-21; no runtime used.
sourceClaims: DXF loading uses its built-in MIT parser.
Open-source DWG loading is opt-in through a LibreDWG converter; a separate proprietary parser is also offered.
sources.disposition: DXF-only projection candidate when pinned; the LibreDWG route is correlated, and the proprietary route requires license/API admission before use. Neither establishes DWG or ACIS semantic support by default.

planChanges: Refine PAR-144's composed checkpoint with a one-time dwg-rs raw-object admission gate and explicit non-use of its currently failing typed VIEWPORT decoder.
Keep app-level OpenCADStudio results separate from ACadRust-independent parser evidence.
Preserve undxf as a version-pinned DXF-only optional comparator; deduplicate uncad's DWG route under LibreDWG.
nextAction: Continue dependency-ready local implementation. At the existing composed checkpoint only, pin dwg-rs and probe raw object-walker capability against generated AC1015/AC1024 outputs; if the raw handle-tail cannot be inspected, mark that route NOT_QUALIFIED and continue with a local bounded structural walk.
